observations.notes: DERIVED, not printed: chip load = feed / (RPM x flutes) = 35 / (27000 x 1) = 0.001296 in = 0.0329 mm. The table prints ONE feed and ONE RPM per V-bit and two stepovers: a Clear Pass Stepover and a Final Pass Stepover.
